channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: A First Lady in a New York Cell
item.description: One year later, Cilia Flores, the wife of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, languishes in a cell in New York City, having been dragged out of her room and kidnapped by U.S. forces on the Jan. 3 attack on Venezuela.

item.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump’s ’emergency’ tariffs
item.description: The Court ruled that the IEEPA does not grant the president authority to levy tariffs, as that power belongs exclusively to Congress under the Constitution.

item.title: Why the Trump administration doesn’t just break the law
item.description: Whether the Trump administration cloaks its actions in legal rationales or disregards legality altogether, communities at home and abroad continue to resist.

item.title: Ramadan under the blockade: The women of Havana’s only mosque
item.description: What will happen to the women living under the boot of the U.S. empire if women here sit back and merely wait for the next election cycle?
